answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short. The design leans on redundant verification across independent nodes. Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tide of the next round.
